# Biography

I am Siva Sai Chandragiri, a Ph.D. candidate in Pathology at the University of Oklahoma Health Sciences Center and an American Heart Association Predoctoral Fellow. My research focuses on cerebrovascular aging, radiation- and chemotherapy-related brain injury, and the vascular mechanisms that contribute to cognitive decline, stroke, and dementia. Using preclinical models, imaging, and transcriptomic approaches, I study how endothelial dysfunction and senescence impair brain health across aging and disease.

## About Me

- **Name:** Siva Sai Chandragiri
- **Program:** Ph.D. Candidate in Pathology
- **Institution:** The University of Oklahoma Health Sciences Center
- **Research Interests:** Cerebrovascular aging, endothelial senescence, radiation-induced brain injury, vascular dementia
- **Email:** [sivasai-chandragiri@ou.edu](mailto:sivasai-chandragiri@ou.edu)

## My Research

My work examines how vascular injury contributes to brain dysfunction in aging and disease. I am particularly interested in cerebral microhemorrhages, endothelial senescence, neurovascular coupling, and treatment-related brain injury.

This website highlights my research projects, data analysis work, and reproducible reports created using R, Quarto, and GitHub.
